description: Design a Lamoi site with the LAFU design library (1 200+ sections, ready pages, headers, footers and shop headers). Reads: library (category, industry, search, page: find designs; slugs look like lafu/saas-hero-mockup), design (slug: its markup and editable spots), sections (pageId: a page's sections and the path of every text, button, image, background, icon, product list, column set and box), presets (colour, font and size slugs, tones and the icon names), part (part header or footer), styles (design sets), designs (the named full site designs, e.g. Aalto, Liekki, with their pages), preview (pageId: a ten-minute link that shows the page, also a draft), login_designs (the designed sign-in pages: photo, shape, SaaS and shop layouts), login (the site's sign-in settings), login_preview (login: a ten-minute link to the sign-in page with other settings, nothing saved), colors_get (the site's colours: own per slot, the design set's own, effective, WCAG AA checks, eight ready palettes). Writes need confirm: compose (sections: [slug or { slug, edits }, ...] so one call builds a finished page, pageId to rebuild it or mode append to add, or title for a new draft; template default, page-wide or canvas; locale fi or en for designs in that language), add (pageId, slug, index?), replace (pageId, index, slug), move (pageId, index, to), remove (pageId, index), edit (pageId, index, edits: [{ path, text | url | image {url or id, alt} | dim | columns | duplicate | remove | tone | icon (an icon spot: a name from presets icons, e.g. truck, shield-check, headset; pick the one that fits the heading under it) | products {category: shop category slugs (comma list, empty = all), order: newest | popular | rating | price-low | price-high | title | random, count 1-24, featured, sale} (a product list spot: make every product row show the right products, never the same list twice on a page) | color {background, text} | font {family, size} | anchor | menu [{label, url}] | insert {block: core/paragraph, core/heading, core/buttons, core/spacer or lamoi/start, text?, url?, at?} }]), replace_text (pageId, pairs: [{ from, to }]: change texts by what they say now, e.g. to translate a page), part_set (part, slug), part_edit (part, index, edits), style (style, keepColors?: false puts the own colours back to the new set's own; default they stay), colors_set (colors: { base?, contrast?, primary?, primary-contrast?, accent?, muted? } as #hex, "" = back to the design's own; reset: true = all back; on any design set, also the sign-in page, sections and shop look; the proposal lists old -> new and contrast warnings), login_set (login: { design?, mode: light | dark | auto, image?: https, title?, text?, widgets?: { announcement, phone, email, address, hours, social: [https], help, staff } }; style?: { primary?, background? (#hex), buttons?: pill | rounded | square, font?: display | body, picture?: color | natural (photo designs: the picture in the main colour or as it is; empty = in the main colour unless image is set), logo?: https or media id, flip?: true, hide?: [name, remember, lost, back] }; only the keys given change, empty text removes a widget), icon (icon: brand | none | media id: the browser tab icon), logo (logo and/or logoDark: none | media id: the header logo and the logo on dark sections such as the footer; import with oma_waas_edit image), apply (design, locale?: a whole site design in one step: design set, header, footer and every ready page, the home page as the front page). Shop look and demo sites (Lamoi with LAFU Blocks 0.6.0 or newer; older sites answer 'not available on this site yet (update Lamoi)'): shop_look without values reads the shop look options (key, label, choices, default) and the current choices; shop_look with values { key: choice value, ... } changes them (confirm, the proposal lists old -> new): use it for product card styles, hover image, category looks, product page, gallery and tab layouts, cart and header styles. shop_look with lookSchema: true reads the JSON Schema of the look (every option and choice, what a choice needs: another LAFU plugin or Pro, and whether it works on this site; choices with available false are refused). shop_look with lookReset (all or a section key such as cards or product) puts that section back to the store default; shop_look with look { key: choice, ... } replaces the whole look (for example an export from another shop; unlisted options go back to default). All writes confirm. demos lists the whole demo sites (demo slug, name, about, kind shop or site, industry, design key, pages, thumbnails, ready; filter with kind, industry, search, page, perPage; current = the demo applied last); demo_plan (demo, keepContent?, trashOld?, samples?, locale?) shows what applying would change: new pages, pages that stay or go to the trash, header and footer, look, shop settings, sample content (no confirm); demo_apply (demo, demoMode apply, keepContent default true, trashOld = old demo pages to the trash, samples = add sample products and posts, keepColors = keep the site's own colours, default false = the demo's colours; the plan's look.ownColors shows them) applies the whole demo site with confirm in one step with one undo point; demo_undo (confirm) restores the site as it was before the demo applied last. Use them when the customer wants a ready-made shop or site instead of single sections. Every write keeps a snapshot; undo is oma_waas_edit. serviceId comes from oma_waas_sites.

action.description: library, design, sections, presets, part, styles, preview, login_designs, login, login_preview, designs, colors_get, demos, demo_plan, shop_look without values and demo_apply with demoMode preview are reads. The others (demo_apply apply, demo_undo) need confirm.

category.description: library: all or a category such as lafu-hero, lafu-headers, lafu-footers, lafu-pages.

colors.description: colors_set: the site's own colours as #hex per slot (base background, contrast text, primary main colour, primary-contrast text on it, accent, muted soft background); "" = back to the design's own.

demo.description: demo_plan and demo_apply: demo slug from action demos.

demoMode.description: demo_apply: preview (default, no confirm) shows the plan; apply needs confirm.

design.description: apply: full site design key from action designs (for example fashion).

edits.description: edit and part_edit: changes, each with a path and one of text, url, image, dim, columns, duplicate, remove, tone, color, font.

icon.description: icon: the browser tab icon: brand (Lamoi icon), none, or a media id.

index.description: Section index from action sections or part.

industry.description: library and demos: all, empty for universal, or an industry key such as restaurant or saas.

keepColors.description: style: false puts the own colours back to the new set's own (default: they stay). demo_plan and demo_apply: true keeps them (default: the demo's colours).

keepContent.description: demo_plan and demo_apply: keep the pages an earlier demo or design made (default true).

kind.description: demos: only demo sites of this kind.

locale.description: compose, demo_plan and demo_apply: texts in this language (demos default to the site language).

login.description: login_set and login_preview: sign-in page settings (design from login_designs, mode light/dark/auto, image, title, text, widgets, style); only the keys given change.

logo.description: logo: none, or the media id of the header logo.

logoDark.description: logo: none, or the media id of the logo on dark sections (footer).

look.description: shop_look: a whole look { option key: choice } that replaces the saved one, e.g. an export (confirm).

lookReset.description: shop_look: all, or a section key (cards, product, ...) to put back to the store default (confirm).

lookSchema.description: shop_look: true reads the JSON Schema of the look (choices with needs, pro and available).

mode.description: compose with pageId: rebuild or add to the end.

pageSlug.description: compose: address slug of a new page.

perPage.description: library: results per page (max 48); demos: max 60, default 24.

reset.description: colors_set: true puts every colour back to the design's own.

samples.description: demo_plan and demo_apply: also add the demo's sample products, categories and blog posts (marked as samples, removed again by demo_undo; default false).

search.description: library and demos: words to match.

sections.description: compose: design slugs in order, or { slug, edits } to change a section on the way in.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

style.description: style: design set name from action styles.

template.description: compose: default, page-wide, canvas (own header and footer) or page-sidebar.

title.description: compose: title of a new draft page.

trashOld.description: demo_plan and demo_apply: move the pages an earlier demo or design made to the trash (same as keepContent false). Customer-made pages are never touched.

values.description: shop_look: { option key: choice value } to change (from shop_look without values). Without values, shop_look reads.

name: oma_waas_design
title: Design a Lamoi site
